motds.body: Break the rules. Change the game! Activate Overrides to switch up the game and explore areas inspired by gaming legends like Sonic, Tetris, and Pac-Man as the future of the Island unfolds.
motds.title: Fortnite: Override Is Here!

motds.body: There are all new Sprites to discover and collect! Extract and equip them for game-changing Sprite Powers, level them up, and keep growing the Collection in Override. Sprites will now appear in Ranked too, with abilities disabled to maintain even competition.
motds.title: Keep Collecting and Mastering

motds.body: Gifting the Override Battle Pass unlocks the Peril Peak Mali Style and matching accessories for both the gifter and the friend receiving it!
motds.tabTitle: Earn the Peril Peak Mali Style
motds.title: Earn the Peril Peak Mali Style

motds.body: From Pandora to Kairos, the Firehawk burns bright! Pick up the Lilith Outfit, with glowing blue Siren tattoos and a Toon alt Style.
motds.title: Lilith Outfit

motds.body: The Dark Knight has been summoned! On September 3, gear up with new Batman vehicles, gadgets, and quests in LEGO Odyssey.
motds.title: Knight Shift Begins Soon

messages.body: Commanders, we've moved the Save the World message of the day to appear when you first log into Fortnite!
messages.title: Message of the day update
